title: Both in the Carrier
hook: Both cats are boxed. The street ahead is ordinary.
scene: Overcast midday on an ordinary two-lane downtown street. The Menace is rolling in the right travel lane. The hard-sided carrier sits CLOSE on the true floor to the right of the tunnel — not on the seat, not on the dash. The door latch is shut and readable. A webbing strap wraps the box and ties to the seat post. Gracie and Mya are both inside — orange tabby with a cream chest, brown mackerel with a dark dorsal stripe — both faces at the grate. Ahead through the mesh the street is ordinary: wet asphalt, brick storefronts, no one in the paint. The cats are cargo. Nobody names the lot.
debrief: Both cats ride in a closed, strapped carrier. The street stays ordinary because the load stayed on the floor.

source.teaching_target: Mya beat: both cats boxed in a closed strapped carrier; ordinary street ahead; nobody names the lot.

image_brief.camera_pose: Camera is inside the Menace cabin, low and close to the passenger-floor carrier — not a wide over-the-wheel road shot, not a look down the pedal box. The closed hard-sided carrier fills the lower two-thirds: grate facing the lens, both cats' faces at the wire, door latch and seat-post strap large enough to read at phone size. Upper third is coarse Menace panel mesh and an ordinary downtown street through intact glass. Overcast midday daylight. Cabin matches the promoted Menace plate (flat painted dash, single nacelle, unbranded wheel, ball-knob floor shifter). Footwell, pedals, boots, shoes, and any hover are out of frame below. Do not attach a footwell plate, a brake-cover plate, or Encore Y4 glass as this cabin.
